card.name: Words just before sex or sexual terms
card.fires_on: Words in sexual-health or sexual-function passages where the next word is likely 'sex', 'sexual' or 'erotic'. It fires on the word before, or partway through, a term such as oral sex or autoerotic.

modes.label: Before 'sex'
modes.description: Linking or modifying words right before the word sex in passages on sexual practices or transmission.
modes.example: Semen is the liquid which is released from a man's penis<< during>> sex which carries sperm.

modes.label: Inside sexual terms
modes.description: Start of a compound sexual term, such as auto-erotic or oral sex.

modes.label: Sexual side-effect lists
modes.description: Words in lists of sexual side effects, such as decreased libido or delayed orgasm.
modes.example: In female patients, SSRI use may result in<< decreased>> libido and delayed or absent orgasm.
